meta.name: keyword-research
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "find keywords", "挖词", or "搜什么词"; prioritizes search volume, keyword difficulty, intent, and topic clusters from provided or connected data. Not for competitor-relative coverage gaps — use content-gap-analysis. 关键词研究/内容选题

copy.tagline: 挖掘高价值关键词，指导内容选题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做内容营销或SEO，需要找到用户搜索的词
copy.tagline_en: Find high-value keywords to guide content topics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do content marketing or SEO and need to find what users search for

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你做关键词研究：根据你给的种子词，挖掘相关关键词，评估搜索量、难度和用户意图，并按主题分组，最后输出一份带优先级的关键词简报。
howto.when: 当你要求“找关键词”、“挖词”、“搜什么词”，或者询问搜索量、关键词难度、长尾词、内容选题时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下“智能手表”的关键词。
say.note: Claude 会启动 8 阶段流程，输出关键词简报。

say.text: 分析“在线英语课程”的搜索量和难度。
say.note: Claude 会评估该主题的关键词机会。

say.text: 为“家庭健身器材”做内容选题。
say.note: Claude 会生成主题集群和内容建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you with keyword research: given a seed term, it discovers related keywords, evaluates search volume, difficulty, and intent, groups them by topic, and outputs a prioritized keyword brief.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "find keywords", "挖词", "搜什么词", or inquire about search volume, keyword difficulty, long-tail keywords, or content topics.

say_en.note: Claude will run the 8-phase process and output a keyword brief.

say_en.text: Analyze search volume and difficulty for "online English courses".
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate keyword opportunities for that topic.

say_en.text: Do content topic research for "home fitness equipment".
say_en.note: Claude will generate topic clusters and content suggestions.
